contexts.text: He brought them to Leah his mother () = application to the affection of external truth. To bring = application.
Unless I bring him to thee () = unless the medium is conjoined... To bring = to be conjoined.
The man brought the men to the house of Joseph () = the first introduction into the good which is from the Celestial of the Spiritual. To bring = introduction.

Because they were brought to Joseph's house () = that the truths which are of the Natural were adjoined and subjected to the internal... To be brought = to be adjoined, and because it = to be adjoined, it = to be subjected. Explained.
Take to thee this child () = that she should adjoin it to herself. To take to = to adjoin.
I have brought you to me () = to the good of love, which is in Heaven... for by means of the truths of faith man is brought to good...
The lord shall bring him to God () = the state into which he then enters according to Divine order... To bring = to enter.
The lord of the house shall be brought to God () = inquiry from good. To be brought to God = in order that inquiry may be made.
Thus is he brought to Him...
By fear... man cannot be brought into spiritual goods, for in proportion as he is brought into these he meditates cunning and deceit...
It is necessary to adduce some things...
